evidence.reason: At the current tip, `Outbox.spool()` validates the value and then immediately writes `canonical(value)` to the pending outbox; there is no `RECORD_BYTES` check before the durable write. An oversized review event can therefore be admitted and persisted, while the publisher rejects records over the bound before pushing any group. That leaves a poison pending record that blocks later valid records until manual removal. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing spool/publish behavior, and the minimal fix is to reject oversized records at spool admission before `atomic(...)` (or equivalently bound the schema fields). No current-contract clause supersedes this.
